notes: Lantern Drift: a third-person floating-island platformer where a paper-lantern spirit collects memory-orbs and evades shadow wraiths across five escalating realms. Procedural geometry, synthesized Web Audio music and SFX, bloom postprocessing, particles, pointer-lock mouse look, touch and gamepad support, pause, high score via localStorage. Known limitations: traversal relies on procedural island chains that are usually but not always cleanly jumpable; bloom loads asynchronously from CDN.
